headline: Carrier Beat Estimates, Raised Its Outlook, And Fell Anyway
summary: The market looked past a small earnings beat to a profit that is still shrinking and a raised target that leans heavily on the back half of the year.

headline: Carrier (CARR) Appoints Neil Barua To Board As Tech Focus Comes Into View
summary: Carrier Global (NYSE:CARR) has appointed technology executive Neil Barua as an independent director. Barua will serve on the Compensation Committee and the Technology & Innovation Committee. The appointment adds experience from his leadership roles at PTC Inc. and ServiceMax to Carrier Global's board.
